links.outcome: Accuracy of GPT-4 nutrition answers graded by dietitians against current knowledge
links.effect: 73/88 (83.0%) correct, 61 (69.0%) comprehensive; 15/88 (17%) mixed with correct and incorrect/outdated data.
links.quote: 15/88 (17%) responses were graded as mixed with correct and incorrect/outdated data.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of GPT-4 responses when each question was entered twice
links.effect: Reproducible responses to 81/88 (92.0%) questions; 7 questions were not reproducible.
links.quote: The model provided reproducible responses to 81/88 (92.0%) questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 accuracy and reproducibility when answering patient nutrition questions about IBD without testing a deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
